name: MxD AI Readiness Test
tagline: A free three-minute executive assessment to help business leaders understand their AI readiness.
description:
The MxD AI Readiness Test is a free three-minute executive assessment that shows business leaders how prepared their organisation is to adopt AI, and where to act first across strategy, data, team, infrastructure, ROI and governance.

Watch out: the page is a three-minute executive questionnaire with a six-part score. It describes a directional snapshot from your answers, not a model that runs your business. Checked 2026-11-14.
